d: With over 14,000 professionals globally, GHD is a leading multidisciplinary professional services company delivering engineering, design, and advisory solutions across water, energy, resources, environment, property & buildings, and transportation sectors.
Our Middle East team is looking for a Graduate Structural Engineer to join our 2027 Graduate cohort, commencing in February 2027.
This opportunity can be based in either our UAE or Qatar offices.

Our two-year Graduate Development Program is designed to give you a smooth start to your consulting career. Alongside your peers, managers and mentors, we’ll help you detangle any challenges along the way. You’ll work collaboratively with peers across other disciplines within GHD, as well as with our clients, and connect across the business to share insights, knowledge and improve your overall technical capabilities.
q: Recent graduate holding a Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering
A strong interest in pursuing a career within Structural Design Engineering
x: Collaborate in a multi-disciplinary, innovative environment where your input shapes both standardised and bespoke solutions.
Join a team that values knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and professional excellence.
Be part of a workplace that combines collaboration, flexibility, and connection. Join us in the office three days per week to contribute, connect and excel in our vibrant environment.

d: Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patients to provide high-quality, patient-centered care in various settings, educate patients and their families, advocate for their needs, and ensure compliance with healthcare standards and regulations.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Nursing from an accredited institution.
Minimum 2 years of recent clinical experience in the relevant specialty.
Must hold a valid UAE Registered Nurse license (DHA, DOH, MOHAP, or DHCC) or a valid Eligibility Letter
r: Conduct initial and ongoing assessments of the patient's current health status and medical history, including monitoring vital signs, symptoms, and any other changes in condition.
Complete and/or review admission data records and document patient information accurately in electronic health records (EHR).
Develop individualized care plans based on the patient's initial assessment, medical history, physician's orders, and physiological, psychosocial, and environmental factors.
Document the patient's care, including nursing intervention, response to care received, patient needs, problems, capabilities, limitations, and progress toward goals.
Communicate with the physician regarding the patient's needs, the nursing assessment results, and recommendations on a daily basis and as needed.
Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by physicians.
Provide wound care, IV therapy, catheterization, and other nursing procedures.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (physicians, therapists, social workers) to provide comprehensive care.
Respond promptly and effectively to emergencies such as cardiac arrest or respiratory distress.
Perform CPR, use defibrillators, and assist in other life-saving procedures as necessary.
Provide emotional support and counseling to patients and families.
Perform indirect patient care using established procedures, policies, and standards.

Educate patients and families about health conditions, treatment plans, medications, and self-care practices, and document the evidence and understanding of these instructions, including them in the medical record.
Provide timely and comprehensive shift change reports to the appropriate person.
Use and store patient care supplies and equipment efficiently, following proper procedures for obtaining, returning, cleaning, and disposing of them, enabling optimal use.
Use equipment correctly and safely according to product information, and maintain it clean at all times.
Provide discharge planning and instructions to ensure continuity of care after leaving the healthcare facility.
Adhere to all safety protocols, infection control practices, ethical guidelines, UAE regulations, and Dubai Health’s policies and procedures
Engage in continuing education and professional development opportunities to stay current with best practices in nursing.
Participate in nursing conferences, workshops, and in-service training.
Seek certifications in specialized areas of nursing, if applicable (e.g., Critical Care Nursing, Pediatric Nursing)
Any other assignments related to the nature of the job assigned by the management
Continuously monitor and interpret vital signs, hemodynamic parameters, and cardiac rhythms.
Assess, identify, and respond promptly to patient deterioration and life-threatening emergencies.
Manage mechanically ventilated patients and monitor ventilator settings and responses.
Administer and titrate vasoactive, sedative, analgesic, and critical care medications as prescribed.
Manage patients with invasive lines, including central venous, arterial, and dialysis catheters.
Assist with intubation, extubation, bronchoscopy, bedside procedures, and emergency interventions.
Monitor and manage patients with sepsis, shock, multi-organ failure, and post-resuscitation care.
Operate and troubleshoot ICU equipment, including ventilators, infusion pumps, dialysis equipment, and monitoring devices.
Maintain strict infection prevention measures, including CLABSI, CAUTI, and VAE prevention bundles.
Interpret and act upon critical laboratory arterial blood gas (ABG) and diagnostic results.
Provide end-of-life care and support patients' families during critical situations.
Maintain readiness of emergency equipment, airway carts, and resuscitation supplies.
Participate in Code Blue, Rapid Response Team (RRT), and disaster response activities.
Assist with Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) or dialysis

d: The Arab Monetary Fund (AMF) is seeking an experienced and highly qualified Senior Economist to join its Surveillance and Financing Department.
Contribute to the preparation of economic surveillance reports, country assessments, and policy notes for member countries.
Conduct macroeconomic, financial sector, debt sustainability, and risk analyses to support economic reform programs.
Develop economic indicators, forecasting models, and analytical tools for policy assessment and surveillance.
Provide policy advice and technical assistance on macroeconomic and structural reforms.
Lead and contribute to research studies on regional and global economic and financial issues.
Draft policy briefs, recommendations, and reports for senior stakeholders and policymakers.
Support the preparation of AMF flagship economic publications and reports.
Design and deliver training programs, workshops, and capacity-building initiatives for member countries.
Build and maintain effective relationships with government authorities, central banks, and international financial institutions.
Monitor economic developments and provide forward-looking policy recommendations to support sustainable growth and economic stability.
Ph.D. in Economics, Finance, or a related field from a recognized university.
Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in economics, finance, research, or policy advisory roles.
Proven expertise in macroeconomic analysis, econometrics, economic modeling, and forecasting.
Strong proficiency in statistical and econometric software, including EViews, STATA, MATLAB, Python, R, and related tools.
Demonstrated experience in economic research and publication in peer-reviewed journals.
Experience in designing and delivering training and capacity-building programs.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in Arabic and English; French language skills are an advantage.
